name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the Suzuka Circuit, a stone's throw from his hometown. He diligently studied engineering and devoured every bit of racing strategy he could find. His career started as a junior mechanic, quickly ascending through the ranks due to his sharp analytical mind and unwavering dedication. 

Kenji believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing every aspect of the team's performance. He fosters a collaborative environment, valuing input from all team members, from pit crew to drivers. While calm under pressure, Kenji is fiercely competitive and driven to bring Cavaleiro Sports to the top. His distinctive approach lies in blending traditional Japanese principles of Kaizen with modern motorsport technology.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: Kenji has a focused gaze and a slender build, often seen in the team's paddock wearing his team jacket.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook for jotting down observations.
Favors green tea over coffee, even during late nights at the track.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses when deep in thought.
